decision.comment: Profiling stage is clean and well-documented. PathMNIST (9-class, 28×28 RGB, standard MedMNIST distribution) is correctly loaded with full official splits (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), no subsampling, and archive integrity verified via MD5/SHA256. Data profile confirms: zero blank images, zero duplicate train samples, modest class imbalance (ratio 1.63), and near-identical class proportions between train and validation (max absolute deviation < 0.0001), indicating no split-level distribution shift. Channel statistics (R≈0.74, G≈0.53, B≈0.71; stds 0.12–0.18) are consistent with H&E-stained histology patches. The eight identified ambiguity risks (e.g., background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma) are inherent to 28×28 resolution and the histology domain; they are appropriately documented and do not constitute a data-quality defect. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is correctly flagged for OOD evaluation awareness. The only open item is the null llm_model_digest for ollama/qwen3.8, which is a reproducibility-verification gap (warning-level, non-blocking) already noted at ingestion. No deterministic findings are present. All evidence supports proceeding to the next stage.
issues: llm_model_digest is null for ollama/qwen3.8; exact model weights are not pinned, limiting full reproducibility verification (warning, non-blocking).
Test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K); OOD generalization should be monitored during evaluation, but this is a documented domain characteristic, not a defect.
